verdict.rationale: Cerebras documents a first-party Batch API for processing groups of requests asynchronously, which covers the async batch submission half of the story. Nothing in the evidence documents a discount for batch versus real-time pricing; the service-tier and pricing items cover priority and rate limits only. missing for 10: documented batch pricing discount versus real-time rates, details on batch job submission/limits/turnaround, independent or hands-on corroboration of the Batch API.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can submit asynchronous batch inference jobs at a documented discount versus real-time pricing

citations.quote: The Batch API lets you process groups of requests asynchronously, making it perfect for workloads where you don't need immediate results
